purpose: Example manifest for a local weekend corpus that documents references without committing screenshot sets.

references.title: Award-style cinematic product stage
references.attributionNotes: Source URL retained; screenshot not captured in this example.
references.composition: Full-screen stage with one dominant object and restrained supporting text.
references.material: Deep surfaces, sharp highlight discipline, strong negative space.
references.motion: Slow reveal or state transition that clarifies hierarchy.
references.interactionModel: Inspect or select one object before seeing deeper information.
references.intentionallyAbsent: No dashboard wall, no badge soup, no source-site watermark.
references.notes: Use as composition evidence, not a production asset source.

topTenCompositionPatterns: Dominant object stage with secondary information held at the edges.
topTenAntiPatternsToAvoid: Using target screenshots or watermarked source images as production assets.
